# Flight 79

> Flight 79 is an aviation-themed cafe and restaurant at Ruko Sasakirana 79, Kota Baru Parahyangan, serving coffee, comfort food, Indonesian dishes, pasta, pizza, desserts, and refreshers for daily dining, meetings, family gatherings, and private celebrations.

## Overview

- Brand promise: First-class flavor on every plate.
- Location: Ruko Sasakirana 79, Kota Baru Parahyangan, Indonesia
- Opening hours: Monday to Sunday, 08:00 to 21:00 WIB
- Parking: Free parking
- Reservations: Via WhatsApp at +62 851-2130-6972 or through the reservation form on https://coffee.flight79.com/#reserve

## Contact & Official Links

- [Flight 79 Website](https://coffee.flight79.com): Main landing page with menu highlights, gallery, events, and table reservation form.
- [Reserve via WhatsApp](https://wa.me/6285121306972?text=Halo%20Flight%2079%2C%20saya%20ingin%20reservasi%20meja.): Direct WhatsApp link to book a table (+62 851-2130-6972).
- [Google Maps Directions](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jz6UKrGxTk31CAoE7): Route and location pin for Ruko Sasakirana 79, Kota Baru Parahyangan.
- [Full Menu PDF](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1n2gVQrpwr0Q3eWKB6p2HI_khHOABcnaI/view?usp=drive_link): Complete Flight 79 food and beverage menu.
- [Instagram (@flightseventyniner)](https://www.instagram.com/flightseventyniner/): Official Instagram account.
- [TikTok (@flightseventyniner)](https://www.tiktok.com/@flightseventyniner): Official TikTok account.
- Email: info@flight79.com

## Menu Highlights

Prices are listed in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR).

### Breakfast & Light

- Butter Croissant (Rp 18.000): Classic croissant with a crisp exterior and soft, layered center.
- Signature Salad 79 (Rp 39.000): Crisp mixed greens served with soy vinaigrette dressing.
- Pre-Flight Omelete (Rp 38.000): Soft, warm omelet made for breakfast.
- English Breakfast 79er - Bread (Rp 55.000): Sunny-side-up eggs, whole-wheat bread, smoked beef, mushrooms, and fresh salad.
- The Cabin Crew's Croissant (Rp 58.000): Buttery croissant with fried egg, potato chips, and fresh salad.

### Main Course

- Nasi Goreng 79 (Rp 58.500): Flight 79 fried rice with fried chicken, satay lilit, and a sunny-side-up egg.
- Cruising Iga Bakar Konro (Rp 90.000): Tender grilled ribs served with fresh, aromatic green sambal.
- Chicken Katsu 79er (Rp 49.000): Panko-crusted chicken fillet served with sambal matah.
- Spaghetti Carbonara (Rp 45.000): Spaghetti in a creamy sauce with savory smoked beef.
- Meat Lovers (Rp 100.000): Selection of meats with melted cheese in every slice.

### Refreshers

- Berry Take-Off (Rp 40.000): Fresh strawberry and blueberry blended with Yakult and ice cream.
- Classic Ice Chocolate (Rp 35.000): Iced chocolate and vanilla-scented milk topped with whipped cream.
- Mango Mojito (Rp 40.000): Soda and mint balanced with sweet mango.
- Morning Glory (Rp 25.000): Green tea, lavender, chamomile, dried lemon, and butterfly pea.
- Strawberry Smoothies (Rp 49.000): Strawberry-banana blend with fresh fruit and granola.

### Coffee

- Espresso (Rp 20.000): Rich, concentrated shot of espresso.
- Americano (Rp 23.000): Espresso with added water for a lighter cup.
- Cappuccino (Rp 32.000): Espresso and milk with soft foam, available hot or iced.
- Café Latte (Rp 32.000): Espresso blended with milk, available hot or iced.
- Iced Coffee 79 (Rp 38.000): Flight 79's house iced coffee.

### Dessert

- Panna Cotta (Rp 37.000): Silky Italian cream and vanilla pudding.
- Creme Brulee (Rp 38.000): Soft vanilla custard beneath a crisp caramelized sugar crust.
- Choco Lava (Rp 37.500): Warm chocolate cake with a molten chocolate center.
- Affogato (Rp 25.000): Vanilla ice cream topped with a hot shot of espresso.
- Matchagato (Rp 30.000): Vanilla ice cream finished with pure whisked matcha.

## Events & Gatherings

Flight 79 hosts private and group occasions, coordinated via WhatsApp (+62 851-2130-6972):

- Birthday celebrations
- Family gatherings
- Corporate meetings
- Community gatherings
- Aviation enthusiast meetups

## Agent Interaction Notes

- Table reservations are completed via WhatsApp. On https://coffee.flight79.com/#reserve, the declarative WebMCP tool `reserve_table` collects guest name, WhatsApp number, date, time (between 08:00 and 21:00), guest count (1 to 30), and optional special requests, then prepares a pre-filled WhatsApp message for user confirmation.
